name: the canvas is 16 by 16 and starts empty and ready
the palette has the 16 fixed colors, reported as lowercase hex
the selected color is marked with aria-pressed
the pencil paints the clicked cell and x runs left to right, y top to bottom
the cells show what the hook reports

steps.expr: (() => { const P = ["#000000", "#1d2b53", "#7e2553", "#008751", "#ab5236", "#5f574f", "#c2c3c7", "#fff1e8", "#ff004d", "#ffa300", "#ffec27", "#00e436", "#29adff", "#83769c", "#ff77a8", "#ffccaa"]; const rows = []; for (let y = 0; y < 16; y++) { let s = ''; for (let x = 0; x < 16; x++) { const c = document.querySelector('[data-testid=cell-' + x + '-' + y + ']').getAttribute('data-color'); s += c === null ? '.' : '0123456789abcdef'[P.indexOf(c)] } rows.push(s) } return rows })()

name: a stroke paints a straight line even when the pointer jumps over cells
strokes work in every direction
one press-drag-release is one undo step, however many cells it touched
a press that changes nothing creates no undo step
undo and redo walk through the history
undo and redo are disabled when there is nothing to undo or redo
a new action after undo clears the redo stack
Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo
the history is at least 100 steps deep
the eraser empties cells, one stroke is one step, erasing nothing is no step
the eraser keeps the color, and picking a color goes back to the pencil
fill floods an empty canvas, in one undo step
fill stops at a closed wall and fills inside or outside only
fill is 4-connected: it does not leak through a diagonal wall
fill follows a winding corridor but not past a sealed wall
fill recolors only the clicked color region, other regions of that color stay
filling with the color the region already has changes nothing and is not an undo step
actions that change nothing keep the redo stack
B, E and F pick the tool and the buttons show it
clear empties the canvas as one undoable step, and clearing nothing is no step
the drawing and the selected color survive a reload
the picture is exported as a 16 by 16 PNG, transparent where empty

steps.expr: (async () => { const P = ["#000000", "#1d2b53", "#7e2553", "#008751", "#ab5236", "#5f574f", "#c2c3c7", "#fff1e8", "#ff004d", "#ffa300", "#ffec27", "#00e436", "#29adff", "#83769c", "#ff77a8", "#ffccaa"]; const u = await window.pixel.exportPNG(); const img = new Image(); img.src = u; await img.decode(); const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = img.width; c.height = img.height; const x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0); const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; const rows = []; for (let y = 0; y < c.height; y++) { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < c.width; i++) { const o = (y * c.width + i) * 4; if (d[o + 3] === 0) { s += '.'; continue } const hex = '#' + [d[o], d[o + 1], d[o + 2]].map(v => v.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''); s += d[o + 3] === 255 ? '0123456789abcdef'[P.indexOf(hex)] : '?' } rows.push(s) } return { head: u.slice(0, 22), size: [img.width, img.height], rows } })()
